subject: JEE Advanced
question: Which statement best distinguishes JEE Main from JEE Advanced?
options: JEE Main acts as stage 1 for NIT/IIIT/GFTI admission and eligibility, whereas JEE Advanced is stage 2 specifically for admission to the IITs
JEE Advanced is taken before Class 10, while JEE Main is taken only after college
JEE Main is for IIT seats and JEE Advanced is exclusively for polytechnic diplomas
Both exams share identical single-choice-only question papers every year

explanation.why: JEE Main qualifies top candidates for JEE Advanced and handles NIT/IIIT/GFTI ranks; JEE Advanced tests deeper multi-concept reasoning for IIT B.Tech/dual-degree seats.
explanation.commonTrap: JEE Advanced also features varied formats (multi-correct, numerical, match) beyond single MCQ.

subject: JEE Advanced
question: True or False: Only candidates who meet the JEE Main qualifying cutoff criteria (alongside eligibility rules) can register for JEE Advanced.
options: True — clearing the JEE Main eligibility shortlist is a prerequisite for JEE Advanced
False — any student may take JEE Advanced directly without ever appearing in JEE Main

explanation.why: JEE Main functions as the screening stage: qualifying in JEE Main Paper 1 shortlist is mandatory before sitting for JEE Advanced.
explanation.shortcut: JEE Main shortlist -> eligible to sit JEE Advanced -> IIT counseling.
explanation.commonTrap: You cannot bypass JEE Main to write JEE Advanced directly.

source: Official Source (JEE Advanced Organizing Institute Guidelines)

subject: JEE Advanced
question: Why is JEE Advanced preparation focused heavily on multi-concept derivations rather than formula memorization alone?
options: Because questions often blend two or more chapters and vary marking formats across years
Because JEE Advanced forbids showing mathematical reasoning
Because questions test only Class 6 geography trivia
Because calculators replace conceptual understanding in the exam hall

explanation.why: JEE Advanced questions integrate mechanics with calculus or electrostatics with optics, rewarding deep first-principles understanding.
explanation.shortcut: Master concepts deeply rather than memorizing isolated formulas.
explanation.commonTrap: Rote formula recall breaks down as soon as a problem twists boundary conditions.
